visual_action: A montage of still images and short video clips of Democratic senators, set against a backdrop of the US Capitol building. The video sequentially shows Mark Kelly at a desk, Maggie Hassan at a podium, Michael Bennet walking in a parade, Raphael Warnock smiling outdoors, and Catherine Cortez Masto standing in front of the Capitol building. Each person is identified with on-screen text.
